description: The llama.cpp runtime in resources/ai/runtime/ is deployed with its Visual C++ runtime dependencies copied next to llama-server.exe (application-directory DLL resolution). No machine-wide VC++ Redistributable installation is required for Portable or per-user Setup distributions, and nothing is downloaded at install or runtime.

sanctionedSource.package: Microsoft Visual C++ 2015-2022 Redistributable (x64), toolset v145
sanctionedSource.note: Copy the DLLs from the VS BuildTools VC.Redist payload (licensed Distributable Code). Never copy them from C:\Windows\System32. The bundled vc_redist.x64.exe is documented here only as provenance/auditing reference for the same payload; the per-user installer never executes it because it requires elevation.

notes: Union of static imports over all 50 runtime binaries (dumpbin /DEPENDENTS, 2026-09-12): the 3 files above plus bundled llama/ggml/mtmd/libomp DLLs, 12 api-ms-win-crt-* forwarders (Windows 10+ inbox UCRT, resolved via ucrtbase.dll), and the listed core OS DLLs. No delay-load imports; no msvcp140_1/2, concrt140, vcomp140, or direct ucrtbase imports.

Only llama.dll, llama-common.dll, and llama-server-impl.dll import vcruntime140_1.dll; every other VC++-dependent binary imports vcruntime140.dll and (except the thin exe stubs and libomp.dll) msvcp140.dll. libomp.dll (LLVM OpenMP) imports only kernel32/psapi.

When the VC++ payload is serviced, re-qualify: copy from the sanctioned payload, rerun the native-dependency gate, and update version/bytes/sha256 here. The app-local copy is serviced by shipping an updated app release; it never downgrades the machine runtime because loader resolution is directory-scoped to the llama-server process.
api-ms-win-* and ext-ms-* API-set forwarders are always treated as Windows-native by the gate; they ship with Windows 10+ and are serviced by the OS.
